one_liner: In the first 15 minutes of international soccer the model trails the market on calibration: model_ece 0.3065 vs market_ece 0.2204 over n=627 checkpoints.
three_things: The earliest window is the weakest for both sides -- model_ece 0.3065 and market_ece 0.2204 are both high.
The model's calibration error runs above the market's here, consistent with an early-game information gap.
Modest but valid sample: n=627, above the n>=30 render floor.
context_note: Descriptive expected-calibration-error on one in-game segment, not a prediction, not an edge or ROI claim. Early minutes carry little score signal, so both model and market are poorly calibrated; the model trailing the market here reflects an information gap, not a measured edge in either direction. ECE on a single corpus is noisy at this sample size.
